dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Let us start with you. How long have you had this cough and has it changed during the week?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I have been coughing for around one week. It is mostly a dry cough and it seems worse at night.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had fever, difficulty breathing, chest pain, or anything else together with the cough?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No fever and no chest pain. My breathing feels normal. It is mainly the cough that is annoying.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: All right. And now I want to ask your child. Can you tell me how you are feeling today?

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: My nose keeps running and I have to keep wiping it. Otherwise I feel okay.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: How long has your nose been running? Did it start today or before today?

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: It started about two days ago.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you felt hot or had a fever?

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: No. I have not had a fever.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I checked the temperature last night as well and it was normal.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Good. It sounds like we are dealing with two different sets of symptoms, so I will make sure we keep your information separate.
